name: HUD Detection
summary: "The machine is listening": a persistent broadcast HUD (brackets, timecode, live transcript, waveform) around very different scenes, every keyword locked in orange detection brackets.

palette.use: black: the ground of every dark scene
warm white: titles, captions, HUD text
orange: keywords, detection brackets, tags, hits, flash-card and CTA grounds
red: the playhead, errors, the thin circle around the core
quiet moments: the serif scene's ground
HUD sub-labels, readouts, the transcript's plain words (proposed)
HUD hairlines, the unplayed waveform, ticks (proposed)
the warm brown radial glow behind dark scenes (measured from the guide's pages)
type and HUD on orange cards (measured from the flash-card frame)
the concentric rings on orange cards (measured)

type.emphasis: orange keyword inside orange corner detection brackets, with a mono readout

banned: music: hits and the voice only
a scene without the HUD frame: it stays on screen the whole video
a keyword without its brackets and readout
a number in the HUD that isn't true (timecodes and counters come from the real clock and words)
more than one giant word on a flash card
colours outside the five (plus the measured orange-card and salmon support tones)
an editing app, templates or AI video for the visuals
SFX over the voice: the voice always wins
